title: Reflective invocation via public_send (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby call public_send selects a class, method, or module at runtime by name. If the name comes from untrusted input, the caller chooses which code runs. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the name is fixed or replaces it with an explicit allow-list of method names.
remediation: Resolve names only from a fixed allow-list, or replace with an explicit allow-list of method names.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any public_send call matches whether or not the name is user-controlled. Regex cannot prove data flow; a constant name is a false positive.
